scope.meaning_of_24_48_96: accepted macro-attempt counts, not tick sizes

source_path_result.candidate_payload: the second of two chained half steps
source_path_result.local_tolerance_use: after all full-step and two-half-step arithmetic, only as the denominator of two discrepancy ratios and the <=1 token gate
source_path_result.advective_guard_use: after each RHS output is computed, only as a refusal gate
source_path_result.commit: validated infallible swap of private candidate and committed payloads
source_path_result.consequence: when an attempt passes both an old and a looser policy, changing only those gates cannot select different already-computed candidate coefficients

current_local_admission.assessment: the only source-established common policy, but the coarse-24 startup is at substantial rejection risk

screening_extrapolation.interpretation: do not start a coarse branch at h256; even h128 startup should be expected to reject under the current local gate until measured

conditional_common_pilot_policy.rationale: 64x local denominators put the h-fifth h128 screen near 0.0632/0.4818; 2x the proven h128 guard accommodates the planned h256 duration only as a screening margin
conditional_common_pilot_policy.limitations: the design forbids promoting h-fifth extrapolation to order evidence; actual h128 and h256 attempts may still reject and must not be retried under changed settings

scientific_policy_unchanged.meaning: global comparison targets remain frozen; local attempt admission is not allocated scientific error and does not establish a window

existing_48_state.source_level_bit_identity_implication: the existing candidate chosen at each attempt also passes the looser conditional gates, and tolerance/guard values are not operands in candidate construction
existing_48_state.evidence_limit: this is not a cross-binary reproducibility result and does not authorize relabelling the archived plan metadata

policy_and_adapter_gap.design_requires: at least three predeclared temporal settings, raw non-extrapolated differences, fixed global budgets, and current-regime order evidence before a Richardson divisor
policy_and_adapter_gap.design_does_not_state: that local acceptance tolerance words must be bit-identical among temporal branches
policy_and_adapter_gap.library_family_constraint: FamilySettings supplies one tolerance object and one advective limit to every branch
policy_and_adapter_gap.snapshot_adapter_constraint: TIME_DIAGNOSTIC same_evolution_except_schedule compares absolute and relative tolerance words exactly; it does not compare advective limits there, although each side must carry a positive admission guard
policy_and_adapter_gap.missing_bridge: a reviewed dominance rule proving each archived attempt passed a componentwise tighter local gate, binding every attempt record and state hash, and distinguishing operational admission metadata from unchanged scientific comparison budgets
policy_and_adapter_gap.required_before_reuse: extend policy and adapter with that explicit dominance proof or run all three branches under literal common metadata; do not edit or silently reinterpret an existing manifest
